details.description: CodeAPI is running from the expected image and data mount but is absent from the active Compose files, has init disabled, and has exhausted pids_limit=256 with 247 zombie children.

change_summary.expected_result: CodeAPI is managed by the active Compose project with init=true, keeps the exact image, data mount, resource limits and security controls, recreates only LibreChat-CodeAPI, accepts /exec requests again, and no longer accumulates unreaped LibreOffice/GnuPG descendants.
functions: Insert a reviewed CodeAPI service block into the active Compose override
Enable Docker init as the PID-1 subreaper while preserving pids_limit=256
Recreate only the codeapi service without --remove-orphans
Verify direct API-to-CodeAPI /exec, public routes and protected container identities
Automatically restore the previous override and no-init CodeAPI runtime on failure
limitations: No image build or dependency installation occurs on production
The existing local/librechat-codeapi:office image digest is reused exactly
One billable model request is allowed only for the affected DOCX business acceptance
change_summary.reason: The orphaned CodeAPI container runs Uvicorn directly as PID 1. LibreOffice/GnuPG grandchildren are not reaped, 247 zombies plus Uvicorn threads fill pids_limit=256, and document analysis fails when /exec cannot fork.
change_summary.risk: Recreating CodeAPI briefly interrupts code execution. A malformed Compose addition could alter runtime identity or leave the service unavailable; exact baseline fingerprints, a remote lock, single-service --no-deps recreation, protected-service ID checks and automatic rollback bound the risk.

details.automatic: Any failure after the Compose write invokes the versioned remote-rollback.py.
details.restore_scope: Restore the timestamped compose.override.yaml.before and recreate only codeapi with the preserved no-init rollback override and exact image.
details.stop_condition: Rollback fails closed if its backup override or rollback service block is missing.
details.unchanged_scope: LibreChat-API, NGINX, RAG, Admin, MongoDB, user data, conversations and uploaded files are not mutated.

validation_plan.expected: Patch idempotency, exact CodeAPI scope, init/resource/security preservation, rollback contract and repository governance pass.
The exact Compose/container/image baseline, 256 PID exhaustion, host resources, dependency interface and rollback image are captured read-only.
Only CodeAPI is recreated with init=true; the image and limits are preserved; direct /exec returns 200; protected IDs and public routes pass.

validation_plan.command: Regenerate the vip998 DOCX request in conversation 78ed6485-3d95-4887-b8e8-cad89c27f0bf, then inspect CodeAPI PID/zombie state.
validation_plan.expected: The document is analyzed without CodeAPI 500 and CodeAPI remains below its PID limit with no zombie accumulation.
